note: Chapter 1 keys the regain from 'Argentina win', Messi's flick from 'Messi flicks', Álvarez's pass from 'who sends', Mac Allister's pass across from 'He passes' and the goal from 'who scores'. Chapter 2 lights the space on 'into the space' and draws Álvarez's pass on 'and Álvarez'. Chapter 3 crosses out the shot on 'He could shoot', draws the pass on 'and finds' and the finish on 'with his left foot'. Chapter 4 is a training-pitch demonstration. Read 'Lusail' as loo-SAIL, 'Mac Allister' as mack-AL-is-ter.

chapters.label: The counter, live
chapters.text: Lusail, 2022, the World Cup final. Argentina win it back. Messi flicks it to Julián Álvarez, who sends Alexis Mac Allister racing forward. He passes across to Di María, who scores!

chapters.label: Watch his run
chapters.text: Watch again from behind. Mac Allister sprints into the space between the defenders, and Álvarez finds him.

chapters.label: The extra pass
chapters.text: He could shoot, but he looks up and finds the free man. Di María finishes with his left foot!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball with calm, safe passes. When a gap opens, speed it up with one quick pass forward!
